title: Aajayiye Baba mere
body:
Aajaaiye baaba mere aajaiye baaba
Noha ye sakina ka tha aajaiye baaba
1. Is qaid se aakar humein chudhwaaiye baba
Aajaiye baba mere aajaiye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ab tab nahi mujhme zaalim ke tamacho ki
Kab tak mai mazaalim sahu batlaiye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Zaalim ne rasan baandhi gale me mere kas kar
Dam rukta hai aakar use khulwaaiye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mare na tamaache mujhe seli na lagaaye
Aap aake zara shimr ko samjhaiye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hai sar khule phupi meri ghairo ke saamne
Chaadar phupi ke waste le aaiye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Soti thi sada aapke seene pe sakina
Kis tarha soou’n khaak pe farmaaiye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baba ye nouha mir ka kar lijiye qubool
Rouze pe apne usko bhi bulwaaiye baba
Kalaam : Meer Kumai ALi
